title: SEO Content Manager
description:
We are working with a globally recognised entertainment brand looking for an experienced Content Producer to join its Consumer Engagement team, with a focus on SEO, GEO and organic content optimisation.

This is a hands-on content role combining editorial production, SEO and emerging AI search practices. You'll be responsible for creating, optimising and refreshing web content to ensure it is useful and engaging for audiences while also being easily understood, retrieved and surfaced by AI-powered search and answer engines.

The Role

As Content Producer, you'll create and optimise editorial content across a major consumer website, using search behaviour, user intent and SEO best practice to identify opportunities and improve organic visibility.

You'll work closely with insights, analytics and wider marketing teams to identify content priorities, while taking ownership of the content creation process from brief and research through to publishing, optimisation and ongoing updates.

Responsibilities include:

Creating, editing and optimising SEO-led editorial and web content based on user needs and search intent

Identifying content opportunities and gaps across priority topics and audiences

Writing clear, engaging and natural-language content that works for both human audiences and AI-powered search engines

Refreshing and improving existing high-performing pages to maintain relevance and organic visibility

Applying SEO and GEO/AEO best practice across web content, including headings, internal linking, semantic structure and metadata

Using keyword, search intent and performance insights to inform content creation and optimisation

Managing content through the full CMS publishing lifecycle, from brief and draft through to review, publishing and iteration

Supporting the editorial calendar and coordinating content delivery with relevant stakeholders

Working with insights and analytics teams to identify priorities and measure the impact of content initiatives

Helping improve organic visibility, SERP coverage, engagement and AI search visibility

Championing SEO and emerging GEO best practice across the wider content team

Ensuring content reflects brand tone, audience needs and relevant cultural or regional nuances

You - Skills & Experience:

Strong experience in SEO content, editorial production and web copywriting, ideally within a major brand or media environment

3+ years' experience implementing SEO content tactics, including on-page optimisation, keyword research, content gaps and search intent

Proven ability to create and optimise content that has improved organic rankings, traffic, visibility or engagement

Strong editorial and copywriting skills, with the ability to produce clear, helpful and engaging content

Hands-on experience working within a CMS and managing content from creation through to publication and optimisation

Good understanding of how content is evolving within AI search, LLMs and answer engines

Experience with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Moz, Google Analytics or similar

Familiarity with GEO/AEO is advantageous, although not essential

Experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) or similar enterprise CMS platforms is advantageous

Comfortable working with insights, analytics and cross-functional stakeholders to inform content priorities

Strong communication skills and the ability to explain SEO concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

Experience working with global audiences and multilingual content would be beneficial

Genuine enthusiasm for console gaming and the PlayStation ecosystem is highly desirable

Sphere Digital Recruitment is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: SEO Lead
description:
Reed.co.uk is looking for an SEO Lead to join their team in Holborn, London.

Overview

Reed.co.uk is one of the UK's leading job sites, appearing in over 1 billion job searches annually and connecting millions of candidates with employers across the country. We're looking for an experienced SEO Lead to take ownership of our day-to-day SEO performance and help drive sustainable organic growth across Reed.co.uk.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who will be an SEO champion within the business. You'll proactively monitor our organic performance, identify opportunities and risks, and turn SEO insight into clear recommendations and priorities. Working closely with our external SEO consultant and Digital PR agency, you'll collaborate across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Content and Marketing to ensure SEO is considered in relevant decisions and opportunities are successfully delivered.

Traditional search will remain at the heart of the role. You'll also help us understand and respond to the evolving landscape of AI-powered search and LLM visibility, ensuring Reed.co.uk is well positioned as candidate search behaviours develop.

Key Responsibilities
- Champion SEO across Reed.co.uk, ensuring organic search is understood and considered in relevant product, content and technology decisions.
- Proactively monitor and analyse organic search performance, identifying changes, risks and growth opportunities and translating these into clear recommendations and priorities.
- Own the day-to-day SEO operation, setting clear briefs and priorities, challenging recommendations where appropriate and holding teams accountable for high-quality delivery and results.
- Work closely with our SEO consultant to help translate SEO strategy into a clear, actionable roadmap and identify opportunities to improve performance.
- Partner with Product, Engineering and Delivery teams to embed SEO best practice, provide input into new products and site changes, and ensure SEO requirements are understood and successfully implemented.
- Identify and diagnose technical SEO opportunities and issues across areas including crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking and structured data, working with Engineering on implementation.
- Work collaboratively with Content and Marketing teams on keyword research, search demand, content optimisation, competitor analysis and opportunities to strengthen organic visibility.
- Monitor search engine developments, competitor activity and emerging AI search and LLM discovery trends, identifying opportunities to test, learn and evolve our approach.

Skills & Experience
- 4-5+ years of SEO experience, with a strong background on technical and on-page SEO and knowledge of Digital PR and how it complements SEO efforts.
- A proven track record of using SEO insight and recommendations to improve organic performance on medium to large sites, e-commerce or platforms with short lived content.
- Good technical SEO knowledge, including crawling and indexing, site architecture, internal linking, structured data and rendering JavaScript / dynamic content with the ability to work effectively with Engineering teams on implementation.
- Strong analytical skills and experience using platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics and enterprise SEO and crawling tools to understand performance, test and discover issues.
- Experience managing SEO agencies or specialist partners, with the confidence to set priorities, challenge recommendations and drive high-quality delivery.
- Excellent communication, collaboration and project management skills, with experience influencing Product, Engineering and other non-SEO stakeholders and translating SEO requirements into clear business recommendations.
- A proactive and commercially minded approach, with the curiosity to investigate performance changes, identify opportunities and prioritise activity according to likely business impact.
- A good foundational understanding of AI-powered search, LLMs and emerging approaches to search visibility, alongside a genuine curiosity to develop your knowledge as the landscape evolves.

Additional Requirements
- Must be located in and eligible to work in the UK
- Must have a 2:1 degree or equivalent (e.g. apprenticeship)

Benefits
- Hybrid working
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Flexible holiday scheme (buy, sell and carry over your holiday)
- Paid time off to move home
- Contributory pension scheme
- Enhanced family leave benefits
- Insurance benefits including life assurance
- Love Mondays events
- Discount scheme including gyms and popular retailers
- Range of wellbeing and mental health support avenues
- Newly refurbished office in an amazing location, with countless bars, restaurants and theatres right on the doorstep

title: Social Media Community Executive
description:
Job Description

Help make investing feel more accessible, one conversation at a time.

Social media is often where people discover AJ Bell, ask questions and join conversations about investing. As our Social Media Community Executive, you'll help make those interactions useful, engaging and genuinely human.

You'll build relationships with our online communities, listen to what matters to them and turn those insights into better content and conversations. You'll also create social-first content and use performance data to continually improve what we do, helping more people feel informed, confident and positive about investing.

What you'll do
- Bring our social media communities to life by responding to comments, messages and mentions in a timely, helpful and brand-appropriate way.
- Build genuine relationships with followers, joining conversations and creating opportunities for people to engage with AJ Bell and investing.
- Use social listening to understand what our audiences are talking about, spotting emerging trends, recurring questions and opportunities to make investing easier to understand.
- Share community feedback and audience insights with colleagues across Content, PR, Brand and Marketing, helping us create communications that are relevant and useful.
- Track reach, engagement, follower growth and community activity, using the results to understand what's working and where we can improve.
- Schedule, publish and optimise platform-native content across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and other relevant social channels.
- Create and adapt engaging social-first content, including short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn, using tools such as Canva and Edits.
- Help maintain a positive and trusted community by recognising when customer service, regulatory or reputational issues need to be escalated and following the right governance processes.

What you'll bring
- Experience managing social media communities and the judgement to respond to different customers, comments and conversations in a helpful and professional way.
- A good understanding of platforms including Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube, and curiosity about how people use them differently.
- Experience with social media management and reporting tools such as Sprout Social, alongside the analytical skills to spot trends and turn performance data into useful insights.
- Clear, engaging written communication and a natural ability to adapt your tone for different audiences and channels.
- Good organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage different activities and deadlines while maintaining quality.
- The confidence to recognise sensitive customer service, regulatory or reputational issues and escalate them appropriately.
- A collaborative approach and an interest in using customer feedback and audience insight to make content and experiences better.
- Experience creating social-first content, editing short-form video or using tools such as Canva and CapCut would be useful, but isn't essential. An interest in emerging social media and AI tools would also be welcome.

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work for the past two years, building on six consecutive years as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For. It's recognition we're proud of and a reflection of the supportive and collaborative culture we strive to create for our people.

title: Warehouse Manager (Light Warehousing/Ecommerce)
company: Regulation GB Ltd - HQ & Warehouse - Agency - Permanent
description:
REGULATION is a London-based adult lifestyle and fetish retailer for the LGBT+ community, established in 1991. We retail via our Soho retail store, online, and have a small warehouse in Walthamstow, North London.

We are looking for a hands-on Warehouse Manager to run the day-to-day operation of our E17 warehouse, from receiving and returns through to picking, packing and despatch. You will lead a small team of two Warehouse Operatives, report to the Directors, and be accountable for stock accuracy, order turnaround and a safe, tidy working environment. This is a working role: you will pick, pack and receive alongside the team as well as plan, organise and improve how the warehouse runs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Running the warehouse
- Plan and oversee daily goods in, picking, packing, returns and despatch so orders leave on time
- Get hands-on. Pick, pack and process stock alongside the team using PDAs, our warehouse and order systems
- Receive and check deliveries and customer returns, and put new stock and returns into the correct locations
- Manage carrier collections and despatch, and resolve courier issues with our shipping partners
- Keep work areas clean, tidy and well organised, and take responsibility for housekeeping and quality assurance

Stock control
- Maintain accurate stock levels and locations, and track stock movement between the warehouse, workshop and our Soho store
- Carry out regular cycle counts and stock takes, and investigate and correct discrepancies
- Flag low package stocks and reorder needs

Leading the team
- Lead, train and support two Warehouse Operatives, setting clear daily priorities and standards
- Manage rotas, holiday cover and absence in line with company policy, using our HR system
- Carry out inductions, regular one-to-ones and annual appraisals, working with the Directors of Operations & HR
- Be involved with recruitment of new warehouse team members in line with HR procedures

Health, safety and performance
- Implement and enforce health and safety procedures, manual handling practice and risk assessments, and report incidents promptly
- Meet agreed KPIs for order turnaround, pick accuracy, stock accuracy and returns processing
- Work with Directors to improve warehouse efficiency, layout and processes
- Report on performance and flag problems early

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

Essential
- At least 2 years of warehouse or stockroom experience, ideally in e-commerce or retail fulfilment
- Experience of leading or supervising a small team, or a clear readiness to step up into it
- Confident with inventory or warehouse management software and PDAs, and comfortable learning new systems
- Strong attention to detail and accurate record-keeping
- Good literacy and numeracy, and clear communication with colleagues and carriers
- Able to prioritise, problem-solve and work at pace without losing accuracy
- Reliable, organised and a team player with a can-do attitude

Desirable
- Experience with order management systems
- Experience working with couriers such as DPD, FedEx and Royal Mail
- First aid or manual handling qualification, or willingness to train
- Experience of recruiting, inducting and appraising staff

Physical requirements
- Standing or walking for long periods
- Lifting, bending, twisting and moving products up to 15kg
- No forklift or MHE operation is required at our site

Please note: REGULATION sells adult lifestyle and fetish products. You will handle and pack these items daily, so you must be comfortable working with adult content.

Benefits

Staff discount,Free Parking, NEST pension, Cycle to Work scheme, Team socials, Casual dress

title: Marketing Graduate
description:
Marketing Graduate

Fully funded Marketing qualification Monthly bonus Croydon Mon-Fri

Think creatively. Act commercially. Deliver results.

Overview of the position

Redwood is seeking a creative and commercially minded Marketing Graduate to join a structured development programme combining formal training, hands-on experience, cross-departmental exposure and increasing responsibility.

During the first 12 months, you will complete the Marketing Graduate Scheme and marketing qualification, developing the practical, technical and commercial skills needed to take a marketing brief from concept through to delivery. The remaining 12 months will focus on applying and developing these skills within the Marketing team.

Why we exist

At Redwood, we believe debt collection should empower businesses, not burden them. Our mission is to help clients grow stronger by taking on the responsibility of debt recovery, allowing them to focus on growing their business.

How we achieve our mission

Working with the Marketing Team and colleagues across Redwood, you will support live marketing activity while developing your skills through structured training, practical projects and regular feedback.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Content creation

Support content across websites, social media, email and other channels, adapting messaging for different audiences and Redwood's tone of voice.
- Campaign support & delivery

Assist with marketing campaigns across organic and paid channels, supporting lead generation and commercial objectives.
- Analytics and insight

Monitor marketing performance using analytics, CRM reporting and campaign data to support future activity.
- Email marketing

Support email campaigns, customer journeys, audience segmentation and CRM activity.
- Projects & cross-functional collaboration

Work with teams across Redwood on marketing projects, events and initiatives, taking increasing ownership as you develop.

What will you bring?

You are naturally curious, creative and keen to build a career in marketing. You are willing to learn, comfortable receiving feedback and interested in understanding how marketing supports a commercial business.
- Education & interest in marketing: Ideally, you will hold a 2:1 or above degree in Marketing, Business or a related subject; with a genuine interest in marketing demonstrated through studies, projects or other activities.
- Portfolio & creativity: A portfolio of relevant work from university, college, placements, internships, employment or projects completed in your own time.
- Communication & attention to detail: Strong written and verbal communication skills, and ability to produce accurate, high-quality work.
- Initiative & development: Able to interpret briefs, use initiative, develop ideas and positively apply constructive feedback.
- Organisation & ownership: Organised, able to manage deadlines and willing to take increasing responsibility for your work.
- Commercial awareness: Interested in Redwood's services, audiences and objectives, with the ability to work collaboratively across the business.

The Graduate Scheme

The first 12 months will follow a structured development plan, with formal reviews at six, nine and twelve months in addition to Redwood's standard three-month probation process.

As part of the scheme, you will work towards a recognised marketing qualification alongside structured internal training and practical, on-the-job development. Training will cover marketing systems and platforms, brand and content, commercial knowledge and cross-departmental exposure. You will work with colleagues across the business to understand Redwood's services, audiences and commercial objectives.

The marketing qualification will be fully funded by Redwood, subject to a training repayment agreement. Repayment obligations will apply if you leave within the first 24 months of employment, with full terms provided separately.

The scheme is designed to develop the skills and experience required to progress towards a Marketing Executive-level position, subject to successful completion, performance and business requirements.

What we believe in

At Redwood, our purpose is grounded in our values:
- We are dedicated: We go beyond just delivering results - we deliver the best possible experience.
- We are respectful: We understand our clients' needs. Handling even the most difficult situations with professionalism
- We make it easy: By taking on the burden of debt recovery, we empower our clients to focus on growing their business.
- We succeed together: We work as a team, both internally and with our clients, because we believe in shared success.

The details

Competitive salary plus monthly company performance bonus, payable following a 12-month qualifying period.

20 days paid holiday per annum (incentive to increase).

Contract: 24-month fixed-term contract

title: Social Media Manager - Paid & Organic
description:
Paid social will be your specialism, but you'll be confident working across organic content too.

We're looking for a social media all-rounder with genuine paid campaign expertise: someone who can confidently plan, build and optimise paid activity, but who also enjoys developing organic content, contributing ideas and being part of the wider social conversation.

Reporting to our Head of Social Media, you'll take ownership of paid social campaigns for a varied portfolio of established B2 B brands, while working alongside our social, PR & creative teams to deliver effective content across the full social mix. It's an ideal role for someone who enjoys the performance and precision of paid media, but does not want to spend everyday solely inside Ads Manager.

About the role
- Paid social leadership: Plan, build, manage and optimise campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and TikTok, focused on objectives including lead generation, brand visibility and website traffic.
- Campaign delivery: Take hands-on responsibility for campaign structure, audience targeting, budgets, bidding, testing, ad copy and creative briefs.
- Performance and insight: Monitor results, identify opportunities and turn campaign data into clear, practical recommendations for clients and colleagues.
- Client advice: Provide informed guidance on paid strategy, platform selection and best practice.
- Organic content: Develop platform-appropriate ideas and copy, create and edit mobile-first video, and schedule timely content aligned with each client's brand.
- Community management: Help clients build stronger online communities by engaging with audiences and responding appropriately to comments and messages.
- Collaboration: Work with our full team to integrate paid and organic social into wider campaigns.
- Growth: Contribute ideas to pitches and proposals, and help identify new opportunities for clients and the agency.

What you'll need
- At least two years' hands-on experience planning, building and optimising paid social campaigns.
- Strong working knowledge of Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and TikTok advertising platforms, including lead-generation campaigns.
- A sound understanding of campaign structure, audience building, segmentation, testing, budgets and funnel optimisation.
- The confidence to interpret data, improve performance and explain results clearly to clients, both via Teams meetings and in-person.
- Evidence that you can also create effective organic social content, including strong copy and short-form video.
